purpose: Second online check of JLPT N5/N4 sample-exam sources (docs/prompts/jlpt-exam-sets.md §3a), re-verifying content/jlpt/source-audit-2026-11-23.json. Metadata only: no question, passage, answer key or audio copied.
method: curl -sI -L (HEAD, one request per URL, 1 s pause, generic desktop-browser User-Agent) for every URL in source-registry.json, external-source-catalog.json, JLPT_ONLINE_SAMPLES, the 16 distinct source audioUrl values in content/jlpt/official/*.json (no PDF URLs are stored there) and every N4/N5 file linked from the official sample pages. Small HTML pages on jlpt.jp (sampleindex ja/en, sample09 ja/en, forlearners, forteachers, policy ja/en, top ja/en, mogiinfo) were fetched with curl GET to map links and read terms. Third-party pages were read with WebFetch after checking robots.txt with curl. GitHub repository metadata and licence files read with gh api. No PDF or MP3 body downloaded; HEAD only. No browser verification, login or paywall bypassed.
